close_date.description: Notice close date; also the row's `valid_until`.

decided_at.description: When the decision was taken (the episodic event time; today the row has no `occurred_at` and rides `valid_from`).

held_posture.description: What the org held at decision time: road, bridge, financial level, active ISO set.

publication_state.description: Whether the decision is private-to-tenant, shared with a client, or consented for emission.

region.description: Region the notice was routed to (NSW, QLD, VIC, WA, ACT).

requirements.description: What the notice requires: road level, bridge level, financial level, ISO set, extraction confidence, and whether each was explicit or inferred.

score.description: Deterministic confidence/rank for the verdict (0.05 bypass, 0.15 NO_BID, 0.5 REVIEW, 0.7–1.0 BID).

source_link.description: Link back to the source notice, where one exists.

source_ocid.description: The public tender/opportunity identifier the decision is about.

tender_title.description: Title of the notice decided on.

unmet.description: The specific requirement(s) not met, or the bypass reason (scope/value/veto).

value_aud.description: Estimated notice value, where the notice carries one.

work_type_id.description: The org's classification of the work, used by the scope-mismatch and veto paths.
